maria-ross: FYI just opened two related PRs—one migrates the cost heatmap example to use the new cost-attribution API and the other renames the tracing hook param from `trace_id` -> `trace_hex`. Links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4124. Can reviewers please check snippets (py/js/rust) and the console dashboard anchor?
devon: on it. quick note: python snippet in PR 4123 failed during lint because we were still passing `trace_id` into the client constructor. patch below worked for me: ```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient(trace_hex="abcdef1234")
```
aj: JS snippet also needs swapping `traceKey`->`trace_hex`. small helper we use in other samples: ```js
function normalizeTraceKey(key){ return key.replace(/-/g, ''); }
client = new ConsoleClient({ trace_hex: normalizeTraceKey(raw) })
```
docs-ci-bot: docs build failed: Error: Broken link to https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/#/overview?anchor=heatmap-alloc (404). See output: 
---
Error: Linkcheck failed for /docs/console/observability/heatmap.md: line 72: anchor not found
---
please fix before merging.
leo: will take JS patch and push to 4123. tagging @aj for review on naming.
maria-ross: thanks. also the heatmap example references an internal dashboard id (old slug). can someone verify the correct anchor? I can update doc if you give me the right link.
devon: updated dashboard slug to `heatmap-cost-attribution` in the console; the anchor should be `heatmap-cost-attribution`. I pushed a docs-only commit to 4123: commit 6a1b3f2.
aj: re-ran local linkcheck, still failing because the markdown example uses a raw URL with a query string that our link-checker treats as different. suggested change: convert to named link reference or escape the URL in angle brackets: `<https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/#/overview?anchor=heatmap-cost-attribution>`
maria-ross: good call. I'll switch to angle-bracketed link. also needs a short before/after snippet in migration guide showing `trace_id` -> `trace_hex` and an example curl test.
devon: curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/trace -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"trace_hex":"abcdef1234","events":[]}'
```
aj: also add a note about JSONL escaping for our examples (we had one weird failure on Windows where backslashes got eaten). small line: "On Windows use single quotes around JSON payloads or escape double quotes." :warning: 
docs-reviewer: quick review notes: please update the console screenshot (heatmap legend changed), and add SDK parity checklist (py/js/rust) in the PR body. if screenshots can't be produced in time, mark the screenshot change as deferred in the PR and mention to follow up in the migration guide.
maria-ross: I can generate new screenshot later today and attach. for now marking deferred in PR 4123.
devon: patched python/snippet and link, pushed 6a1b3f2 -> 6a1b3f3 with angle-bracket link and updated curl note.
